case.description: A procedurally drawn stand-in, so no real person is shown. Walks through every stage: capture, genealogy, timeline, complaint and monitoring.
case.title: Demo 3 · Morphed image of a private individual (fully synthetic)

safety_notices.title: Intimate imagery (NCII)
safety_notices.text: Previews are blurred by default. StopNCII.org can create hashes on your own device so participating platforms can block re-uploads without you sending the image to anyone. Under the IT Rules (as amended in 2026) platforms are expected to remove intimate or artificially morphed images within about 2 hours of a complaint from the person depicted. Verify the current rule text with a lawyer or the police.

verdict.label: fake
verdict.headline: Fake
reasons: Proof in the file: A copy of the same underlying media (“Forum [DEMO]: anon_uploader_77”) carries verified generation evidence: Embedded generation parameters identify the tool family: Stable Diffusion (AUTOMATIC1111/Forge-style parameters); model/checkpoint: sd_xl_base_1.0.
caveats: A verdict says how the picture was made, not who made it or whether the event it shows happened.
verdict.reliability: Tested on 640 images from AI generators and photo sources it had never seen: right 68% of the time overall — real photos called real 87%, fakes caught 48%; when the verdict is not 'Uncertain' it was right 74%.
verdict.summary: This is very likely fake (AI-generated image) — 99% likely fake.
